Anabarbis, O sovereign mistress of true melancholy, the poisonous damp of night despondge upon
me, that life, a very rebel to my will, may hang no longer on me.
Throw my heart against the flint and hardness of my fault, which being dried with grief
will break to powder and finish all foul thoughts.
O Antony, nobler than my revolt is infamous, forgive me in thine own particular, but let
the world rank me in register a master-leaver and a fugitive.
